# telnyx_verify_profile_message_template (Resource)

A message template for Verify codes. The Telnyx API cannot delete templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The API cannot delete templates, so destroy only removes it from state.
resource "telnyx_verify_profile_message_template" "example" {
  text = "Your {{app_name}} verification code is: {{code}}."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `text` (String) The text content of the message template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The object's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_verify_profile_message_template.example <id>
```
